description: This line plot illustrates the overall ROUGE-G score, which is the geometric mean of ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L, for various pre-trained models across different numbers of training examples on the multi-document summarization task. The x-axis, labeled “# Training Examples,” uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 64, with tick labels at intervals of 16. The y-axis, labeled “Overall ROUGE-G Score,” uses a linear scale ranging from 11.0 to 19.0, with tick labels at intervals of 1.0. The plot contains six lines representing different model configurations: PELMS (solid green line with circle markers), PELMS (5%) (dashed green line with circle markers), Primera (solid red line with square markers), Primera (5%) (dashed red line with square markers), Centrum (solid blue line with triangle markers), and Centrum (5%) (dashed blue line with triangle markers). The PELMS model (solid green) starts at approximately 16.8 and increases to about 18.8. The PELMS (5%) model (dashed green) starts at about 17.0 and increases to approximately 18.0. The Primera model (solid red) starts at about 15.0 and increases to about 17.5. The Primera (5%) model (dashed red) starts at about 15.0 and increases to approximately 17.0. The Centrum model (solid blue) starts at 13.5, dips to a minimum of 11.5 at 16 training examples, then rises to 14.0. The Centrum (5%) model (dashed blue) starts at about 14.0, dips to a minimum of 13.0 at 16 training examples, then rises to about 15.0.
